subject: SIG: proposed change window for upcoming revision and evidence links

Cc: security@acme.com, Priya Raman <priya.raman@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG -- heads up on upcoming revision + ask for re-answers

Hi Rachel,

Heads up: our procurement/security team received notice that SIG is releasing a minor revision (vNext) that includes a handful of control clarifications. We need Redwood to confirm which of our previously submitted answers will change and provide any diffs/re-answers by the end of September so we can keep the review on schedule.

Specifically we need: 
- A redline/diff file that maps old answers to new (per-question).
- Any updated evidence for changed answers (screenshots, policy excerpts, artifact links).
- A single point of contact for follow-ups.

Are you able to commit to a 10-business-day window to deliver the re-answers and evidence? If yes, please confirm the owner and an ETA.

Thanks,
Daniel
Security Program Manager
Acme Corporation

Thanks for the heads up. We can own the re-answer process. Proposed plan:

1) Confirm scope and map questions (we will produce a "per-question diff" spreadsheet).
2) Identify owners for any evidence updates (policy, screenshots, runbooks).
3) Deliver initial draft re-answers + attachments within 10 business days from today (by 2026-09-27 PDT).

Owner: Rachel Kim (primary), with Mina Haddad (security engineering) as evidence lead. I will copy our Sales/AM to coordinate turnaround.

Attachments: SIG-vNext-diff.xlsx (workbook), evidence-index.csv (index), network-architecture-diagram.pdf (arch)

Best,
